title: 第421章 李小刀升邪竞技场第420章 神通交换900亿
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
第421章：李小刀，升邪竞技场。
姬浩心里咯噔一下。
他早就盯上那间屋子了。
整座领地都是玄黄园林风格，
唯独那片被黑雾裹得严严实实，
三步一岗五步一哨，
连只苍蝇都飞不进去。
仇劫每天晚上都要进去待一个时辰，谁靠近都不行，连姬豪杰上次凑过去都被拦了回来。
眼看仇劫的身影没入黑雾，
姬浩不动声色退到阴影里，神通悄然运转。
“大愿听术！”
温润的愿力贴着地面蔓延，
绕过外层结界的缝隙，
一点点探进黑屋之中。
起初，
耳边只有压抑的寂静，
片刻后，
一阵撕心裂肺的哭声断断续续传了过来。
“爹……孩儿不孝……”
“这笔血债，我一定要他们百倍偿还……”

再往后便是低沉的呜咽，
夹杂着咬牙切齿的诅咒，
被结界挡了大半，
模糊不清。
姬浩连忙收回神通，心沉了下去。
供奉始祖？
骗鬼呢！
他正暗自琢磨，
身后忽然传来一阵窸窸窣窣的动静。
姬浩侧身望去，
只见姬豪杰的身影鬼鬼祟祟摸向黑屋方向，手里还捏着枚破界玉符，摆明了要硬闯结界。
姬浩：“……”
这位少主的好奇心，
真是比猫还重。
他也没动，
就站在阴影里看戏。
果然，不过三息，黑屋周围骤然爆发出刺眼黑芒，结界反噬轰然炸开！
“谁！”
仇劫冰冷的声音从屋内传出，
带着滔天怒意。

他推门而出，
脸色阴沉，
一眼就锁定了结界外的姬豪杰。
content_en:
Chapter 421: Li Xiaodao, Shengxie Arena.
Ji Hao's heart skipped a beat.
He had already set his sights on that room.
The entire territory is decorated in a black and yellow garden style.
Only the area was tightly wrapped in black mist,
Three steps, one post, five steps, one sentry,
Not even a fly can fly in.
Qiu Jie had to go in and stay for an hour every night. No one could get close to him. Even Ji Haojie was stopped the last time he approached.
Seeing Qiu Jie's figure disappearing into the black mist,
Ji Hao calmly retreated into the shadows, his magical powers quietly operating.
"Great wish to listen to the art!"
The gentle willpower spreads against the ground,
Bypassing the gaps in the outer barrier,
Little by little, he probed into the dark room.
At first,
There is only oppressive silence in my ears,
After a while,
A heartbreaking cry came intermittently.
"Dad...the child is unfilial..."
"I will make them repay this blood debt a hundred times..."
What follows is a low whimper,
Mixed with gnashed curses,
Most of it was blocked by the barrier,
Blurred.
Ji Hao quickly withdrew his magical power and his heart sank.
Worship the ancestor?
What a liar!
He was thinking secretly,
Suddenly there was a rustling movement behind him.
Ji Hao looked sideways,
I saw Ji Haojie's figure sneaking towards the black room, holding a boundary-breaking jade talisman in his hand, making it clear that he wanted to break through the boundary.
Ji Hao: "..."
The curiosity of this young master,
It's really heavier than a cat.
He didn't move either,
Just stand in the shadows and watch the show.
Sure enough, within three breaths, a dazzling black light suddenly erupted around the black room, and the barrier exploded in response!
"Who!"
Qiu Jie's cold voice came from inside the house,
With overwhelming anger.
He pushed open the door and walked out,
His face was gloomy,
He immediately locked onto Ji Haojie outside the barrier.
